crossRefs.note: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus…
As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

parallels.note: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus…

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

translations.web: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
translations.bsb: As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Him.
translations.kjv: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
translations.asv: And as they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
